sources.observation: Shallow horizontal recesses separate the outward-flaring concrete bands. The street canopy links the main rotunda to the smaller Monitor building.

sources.credit: Sam valadi / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0
sources.observation: A radial glazed oculus sits inside the main parapet. The tall rear tower, smaller roof dome, broad walkway, and raised service plant remain distinct.

limitations: The model covers the exterior and glazed roof assemblies. Spiral display ramps and gallery interiors are outside this scope. Some small roof fixtures and masonry seams are estimated.
